ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Invoke-Item From Mount-DiskImage
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may abuse container files such as disk image (.iso, .vhd) file formats to deliver malicious payloads that may not be tagged with MOTW. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Mount\\-DiskImage\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ImagePath\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-Volume.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.DriveLetter.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*invoke\\-item\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\)\\:\\\\.*"))
